blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "**-ее**" (sometimes shortened to "**-ей**") to the stem of the adjective: **новый** — **новее**; **красивый** — **красивее**. This comparative form is the same for all genders and the plural. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Сегодня Марал стал ___ (старший) на один год.
exercises.prompt: Today, Maral became a year older.
exercises.why: Note the use of the preposition "**на** + Acc." in such expressions as: **старше на два года** — 2 years older; **длиннее на пять метров** — 5 meters longer. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
